point: Scheme ka correct name: CCS (Leave Travel Concession) Rules, 1988.
example: Asha ki family LTC application: LTC rules check karo, pension rules nahi.

point: Start date = Gazette publication date, not signing date.
example: Signed 3 May, published 21 May? Publication trigger uses 21 May. Hypothetical dates.

point: Coverage is subject to Rule 1(4). Included does not mean automatic approval.
example: Union civil post, but part-time job? Exclusions bhi check karo.

point: Union civil services/posts covered; Defence civilian staff expressly included.
example: Meera, civilian Defence clerk: Defence office alone is not an exclusion.

point: State employee on deputation with the Central Government is covered.
example: Raghav: State cadre to Central Ministry. Rule 2 conditions bhi check hongi.

point: Government contract appointments included; vendor employment is not automatically equal.
example: Neha has a direct Government contract: contract status alone does not exclude her.

point: Persons re-employed after retirement are included, subject to conditions.
example: Dev has an actual re-employment appointment. Pension alone is not enough.

point: Non-whole-time Government employment is excluded.
example: Three-hour daily part-time job: long duration does not make it whole-time.

point: Casual and daily-rated employment is excluded.
example: Salim, daily-rated: twelve months alone does not remove the exclusion.

point: Persons paid from contingencies are excluded. Check actual engagement category.
example: Kavita's category matters; an office contingency budget alone proves nothing.

point: Railway servants: general exclusion, with a later conditional All India LTC window.
example: Limited All India facility does not create ordinary Hometown LTC.

point: Members of the Armed Forces are excluded; civilian Defence staff are different.
example: Army officer and civilian Defence clerk: same building, different service status.

point: Local recruits in Indian Missions abroad are excluded.
example: Paris local hire and India-based posted officer: recruitment status alag hai.

point: Other-concession eligibility matters, not only actual use. Check later instructions.
example: Another benefit unused? That alone is not enough. No blanket private-spouse LTA ban.

point: Rule 2(1) covers Rule 1(3)(ii), (iii), (iv). Read re-employment continuity too.
example: State deputationist, contract officer, re-employed officer: apply the correct tests.

point: One year of continuous Central Government service must be complete.
example: Neha: four-year contract, only six months served. Duration is not completed service.

point: Appropriate administrative authority must certify the required likely service period.
example: Employee's four-year promise is not a substitute for the authority's certificate.

point: Hometown: at least two years, reckoned from joining. Not two extra years after trip.
example: Jan 2026-Dec 2027 contract: Feb 2027 may pass this limb, with proper certification.

point: Any Place in India: at least four years, reckoned from joining.
example: Jan 2026-Dec 2029: Feb 2027 has one year complete and four-year total tenure.

point: Initial one-year contract later extended? Total contract duration counts.
example: Neha's 2026 contract extended without gap to 2029: use the actual extension order.

point: Immediate re-employment without a break: old and new service continuous for LTC.
example: Retire 31 Oct; re-employed 1 Nov. Do not automatically reset the one-year clock.

point: Provided-that test: would LTC have been allowed if the officer had not retired?
example: Sana already used the All India occasion. Next-day re-employment does not refill it.

point: Official illustration: no second All India occasion in the same used four-year block.
example: Dev used 2026-29 All India LTC before retirement. No-break re-employment: no reset.

point: Scope: the employee and eligible family. Rule 3 has no numbered sub-rules.
example: Eligible employee travels alone. Family not accompanying is not itself a bar.

point: Read family coverage with Rule 4(d). Full family definitions are in the next batch.
example: Spouse and friend travel together. The friend is not eligible family just by joining.

point: Rules 9/11 and FAQ 6 allow separate groups/times, subject to applicable conditions.
example: Employee in June, family in October: separate dates alone do not disqualify.

point: Autonomous-body officer deputed to Centre: temporary-servant treatment for that period.
example: Iqbal is not excluded just by parent body. Check category and deputation terms.

point: Industrial/work-charged staff entitled to regular leave are eligible on normal conditions.
example: Regular-leave work-charged employee: no blanket rejection based on the job title.

point: Consolidation unclear or conflicting? Check the relevant governing OM/order.
example: Do not treat an unclear summary as a new amendment. Cite the applicable order.

point: Teaching checklist, not a new rule: coverage, exclusions, service and old block history.
example: Passing these gates is not payment approval. Other journey/claim rules still apply.
